title: The Phantom Beauty of Kobe Rokko
original_title: 江戸川乱歩の美女シリーズ　神戸六甲まぼろしの美女　江戸川乱歩の「押絵と旅する男」
overview: While out for a stroll, the famous detective Kogoro Akechi enters a museum and encounters a woman staring at a poster of someone who looks exactly like him. The woman is the renowned art photographer Fujiko Maiya...
